# Best MagSafe car mounts (Qi2)

**Best for most iPhone drivers: Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W Vent Mount, about $47.99**
- Three reviews pick it as best overall ([RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [CloudsPress](https://www.cloudspress.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/)).
- It includes a 27W car adapter and a USB-C cable, and it rotates between portrait and landscape.
- It fits cases up to 3 mm thick.
- Vent slats need to be 3 mm thick or less and 20 mm deep or less. Straight horizontal slats work best, and vertical ones may droop.

**Fastest charging and best cooling: Anker Prime Qi2 25W (MagGo AirCool), $89.99 list**
- It uses thermoelectric cooling plus a fan, and it's the one the Mount Guys reviewers use daily ([Mount Guys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/)). The Gadgeteer lists it at $69.99 on sale ([The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/)).
- It only reaches 25W on newer phones (iPhone 16 Pro Max/16 Plus and 17), and older iPhones top out around 15W.
- It isn't compatible with Tesla or Mercedes-Benz vents.
- The sources disagree on the adapter. Mount Guys and The Gadgeteer say a 60W adapter is in the box, while RottenWiFi says you need your own 45W+ adapter. Check the listing before you buy.

**Best value with a fan: ESR HaloLock Qi2 with CryoBoost, 15W**
- It has a built-in fan that helps prevent heat throttling when you run maps in the sun. It mounts on a vent or the dash.
- The Gadgeteer lists it at $18.99, but ESR's store lists it at $39.99. The two sources may be describing different versions or sales.
- ESR's store has it at $39.99, or about $32.80 with code PARTNER18, per the Dealectric listing. It's an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you. [Buy at ESR](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost) and check the final price at checkout.
- It may not include a car adapter, so budget about $10 to $15 for one.

**Cheap and flexible: LISEN 15W Qi2 mount, about $15.99 to $26.79**
- It mounts on a vent or the dash with suction, and its 24 magnets are rated at 3800gf, though magnet-force claims on cheap listings are often unreliable.
- Mount Guys advises ignoring "suction pounds" and "gf" claims on cheap Amazon listings.
- LISEN also makes a 25W fan-cooled version at $39.95 with a 95W adapter included, per The Gadgeteer.

## Quick picks
- **Just want it to work:** Belkin.
- **Hot climate, heavy navigation use, or a newer iPhone:** Anker Prime.
- **Tight budget:** ESR or LISEN.
- **Need power-cable-free:** Mount Guys likes the VICSEED steel-core vent mount, which doesn't charge.

Two caveats apply to all of these. Look for the Qi2 badge, because "MagSafe-compatible" alone can mean slower 7.5W Qi charging. And check your car's vent type before choosing a vent mount.

I couldn't browse directly, so I can't give exact product-page links for Belkin, Anker, or LISEN. The review pages above each have Amazon buy buttons for them. Prices came from the sources and may have changed.

If you tell me your phone model and vent style (horizontal, vertical, or round), I can narrow this to one pick.
